Hi Sara — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can get you live quickly: 

1) Procurement readiness items we heard from your team:
- AP requires vendor onboarding (W-9 + supplier form) and SOC 2 evidence before vendor is created.
- For production contracts above $50k/year they prefer Purchase Order (PO) + Net 30.
- One-off POCs under $5k–$10k can be paid by corporate card but need a cost center and cardholder approval.

2) Commercial path options we discussed:
- Option A (Preferred per your AP): Standard contract + PO onboarding. Timeline: 2–3 weeks for onboarding once forms returned.
- Option B (Fast POC): Use card to pay first month or pilot fees and convert to PO for production.
- Option C (Marketplace): If you prefer AWS/GC/Marketplace procurement, we can explore listing/marketplace invoicing — that path requires marketplace procurement approval which can add 3–4 weeks.

3) Our asks / next steps:
- Sara: can you confirm whether Acme will require PO for the initial pilot or if card payment is acceptable? If PO, please share the supplier onboarding form or the contact at AP to send the W-9 and supplier packet.
- Rafael & Priyom (cc): I'll need a 1-page pricing confirmation and a short SOC2 summary from you to attach to the supplier package. I've attached the proposal and the SOC2 summary draft in case it's helpful.

I can send a condensed statement-of-work for AP if that speeds the supplier creation. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with AP if helpful.

Hi Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the points from AP and procurement side: 

- For any vendor we plan to put on file, AP requires a completed Supplier Onboarding Form and a current W-9. SOC 2 evidence is requested for vendors that will process customer data; for pilots that only use synthetic/test data we can accept a SOC2 summary but will request full reports for production.
- PO is our standard for engagements expected to exceed $50k/year. For small pilots under $10k, we typically allow payment via corporate card as long as the cardholder signs off and the cost center is provided.
- Marketplace purchases are governed by our cloud procurement team; they prefer marketplace for standard SaaS but it adds coordination and usually a 3–4 week lead time.

Action items from me: I will share the Supplier Onboarding Form by EOD and loop AP (ap@acmedata.com) to start the vendor record. We may request the W-9 from Redwood directly — can you confirm whether Camila or Redwood Legal will provide that? Also please send the short SOC2 one-pager Rafael referenced.

Thanks — Sara
